status.label: Needs boundary and OS-snap evidence
status.detail: The report maps padding thresholds well, but disabling Windows Snap removes the behavior, so evidence is needed to separate FancyZones placement from native border hit testing.

actions.label: Ask for recording and zone geometry

comment.body: Could you attach a short recording with the pointer visible and export the affected FancyZones layout? Please include monitor resolution/scaling, the exact zone padding, whether the zone touches the monitor work-area edge, and comparison results for Explorer and Opera with Windows Snap enabled. A PowerToys bug-report ZIP would also help confirm the calculated zone and window rectangles.
